name: gmail-newsletter-digest
title_zh: 从Gmail订阅里挑出必读，生成早晚报
tagline_zh: 订阅邮件堆成山？它替你扫完收件箱，挑出真正值得读的链接，按你的语言和时段生成晨报/晚报，还能定时发到指定邮箱。
tagline_en: Inbox overloaded with subscriptions? It scans Gmail, surfaces must-read links, builds a morning/evening brief in.
desc_en: Generate or revise a Morning/Evening Newsletter from Gmail email newsletter subscriptions—also for digest/brief/morning/evening runs, discovering must-reads from the inbox, link QA, language choice, email delivery to a specified address, and daily timed generation. Use whenever the user wants a newsletter built from email subscriptions (not social/X feeds). Prefer this skill over ad-hoc drafting.
why_zh: 不是简单聚合，而是先做链接质量检查，再按你的偏好选语言和时段，生成可读的摘要，省去手动翻找的功夫。
why_en: It doesn't just aggregate—it QA-checks links, respects your language and timing preferences, and produces a digest you'd.
limit_zh: 只处理Gmail中的邮件订阅，不含社交/X信息流；需要Gmail API权限；生成的是摘要链接，不重写全文。
limit_en: Only works with Gmail subscriptions, not social feeds; requires Gmail API access; outputs link digests, not full rewrites; scheduling needs extra.
title_en: Pick must-reads from Gmail subs into a daily brief
